summary: Iteration 7 regression pass for code-review bug fixes (undefined vars in twilio_service/stripe_service/credentials_service, empty catches in AuthProvider+Team+PhoneSms+PaymentResult+Integrations, stale-closure in Inbox.load, index-as-key across 5 pages). Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass covering all listed regression assertions (plans, login JWT, Stripe checkout + checkout-bundle happy paths with the new None-guard, twilio invalid-creds 400, scribe templates + multi-tenancy, compliance profile, SMS webhook STOP/HELP with fresh From numbers, team invitations→signup, SMS send gated 400 not 500). Frontend: /roi calculator interactive assertion PASS (net $33,681 → $71,067 on DVMs slider); /app/inbox, /app/team, /app/integrations all render with 0 console errors and 0 unhandled promise rejections; Integrations shows Connected · Iter7Seed Twilio badge (seed from this iteration).

issues: Payback hint shows 'Payback in ~-1 days' when DVMs slider is at max (net > monthly cost by wide margin, formula produces negative days). Pre-existing from iter-6, worth pluralization + non-negative clamp.

critical_code_review_comments: test_iter7 initially failed on 4 tests due to schema mismatches with previous testing assumptions (all fixed in test file, none are product bugs): /api/plans returns {plans:[...]} wrapper (not bare list); scribe lookup_key is vetaura_scribe_addon_monthly not vetaura_scribe_monthly; /api/payments/checkout and /checkout-bundle both require origin_url in body; /api/twilio/sms/send request field is phone_e164 not to. The request-doc in the review request should be updated for consistency.

Iter-5 seed data (twilio_credentials + twilio_numbers for vet1's clinic) is still in DB; iter-7 seed overrides webhook_token with test_iter7_wh_tok and phone +15550000000 as instructed. If subsequent iterations depend on the iter-5 webhook_token=test_wh_token_iter5, they will need to re-seed.
seed_data_creation: Overrode twilio_credentials.webhook_token=test_iter7_wh_tok and twilio_numbers phone=+15550000000 for vet1's clinic (clinic_c35f55f348ba). Used From=+15551239999 and +15551239998 for STOP/HELP to avoid state pollution from prior iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: vetaura_token is the localStorage key (not 'token' or 'auth_token'). Signin page is at /login (not /signin). Auth to backend for UI tests: POST /api/auth/login → set localStorage.vetaura_token then navigate. Inbox message items do NOT have inbox-item-* testids — only inbox-filters and inbox-generate-draft; inbox rendering is verified visually + by clean-console. All three iter-7 protected pages (/app/inbox, /app/team, /app/integrations) render clean with no console errors for authenticated vet1.
rca of the issue: N/A — all iter-7 fixes verified working; no product bugs found. Only test-side schema mismatches (fixed in-place).
